flow_overview: A cruise website landing-page flow for configuring and launching a cruise search using destination, departure port, month, and duration filters.

requirements.text: The system shall allow users to select sailing dates at month and year granularity across multiple years.
requirements.rationale: The date criterion is visibly selectable at month-year granularity across multiple years.

claims.claim: The system supports sailing-date selection at month and year granularity.
claims.claim_text: The system supports sailing-date selection at month and year granularity.

claims.claim: The system provides month-and-year options across multiple years.
claims.claim_text: The system provides month-and-year options across multiple years.

requirements.evidence_note: Step 6 shows months grouped under multiple years, and step 7 shows a specific month-year choice selected.

requirements.text: The system shall expose only genuinely searchable or available itinerary options for the user's query context when presenting destination, port, date, and duration choices.
requirements.rationale: The core availability claim cannot be reliably judged from the visible screenshots alone.

claims.claim: The system presents itinerary options for destination, departure port, month, and duration choices.
claims.claim_text: The system presents itinerary options for destination, departure port, month, and duration choices.

claims.claim: The presented itinerary options are genuinely searchable or available for the user's query context.
claims.claim_text: The presented itinerary options are genuinely searchable or available for the user's query context.

requirements.evidence_note: The option lists are visible, but the screenshots do not expose inventory, availability, or searchability logic behind those options.

requirements.text: The system shall preserve already selected cruise search criteria when the user leaves the search flow and returns later in the same browsing session.
requirements.rationale: Current-flow retention is supported, while the later return condition is a flow coverage gap.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall retain the selected destination in the search controls while the user configures the rest of the query.

claims.claim: Already selected cruise search criteria can remain selected during the same browsing session.
claims.claim_text: Already selected cruise search criteria can remain selected during the same browsing session.

claims.claim: Already selected cruise search criteria are preserved after the user leaves the search flow and returns later in the same browsing session.
claims.claim_text: Already selected cruise search criteria are preserved after the user leaves the search flow and returns later in the same browsing session.

requirements.evidence_note: The selected criteria persist during the visible in-flow configuration sequence, but no leave-and-return sequence is shown.

requirements.text: The system shall present search results only for sailings that are currently available under the combined selected destination, departure port, sailing month, and duration filters, and shall show user-facing feedback when no matching cruises are available.
requirements.rationale: Filter setup is supported, while result availability correctness and no-match feedback are not verified.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall return cruise results that reflect the combined selected destination, departure port, month, and duration after the search is submitted.

claims.claim: The combined destination, departure port, sailing month, and duration filters can be configured before search.
claims.claim_text: The combined destination, departure port, sailing month, and duration filters can be configured before search.

claims.claim: Search results are limited to currently available sailings under the combined selected filters.
claims.claim_text: Search results are limited to currently available sailings under the combined selected filters.

claims.claim: The system shows user-facing feedback when no matching cruises are available.
claims.claim_text: The system shows user-facing feedback when no matching cruises are available.

requirements.evidence_note: The combined search criteria are visible before submission, but no submitted results or no-results state is shown.

requirements.text: The system shall return all cruises that satisfy the configured destination, departure port, sailing month, and duration criteria, without omitting any eligible sailings.
requirements.rationale: The completeness of returned cruises cannot be judged from the screenshots.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall return cruise results that reflect the combined selected destination, departure port, month, and duration after the search is submitted.

claims.claim: The configured cruise criteria are available before submission.
claims.claim_text: The configured cruise criteria are available before submission.

claims.claim: All eligible cruises satisfying the configured criteria are returned without omissions.
claims.claim_text: All eligible cruises satisfying the configured criteria are returned without omissions.

requirements.evidence_note: No results page, complete inventory reference, or post-search result set is shown.

requirements.text: The system shall provide the same cruise search criteria and equivalent search behavior to anonymous users and signed-in users unless a visible policy restriction is communicated.
requirements.rationale: The comparative requirement cannot be reliably judged without an anonymous-user state.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall support cruise discovery through a single search workflow that combines destination, departure port, departure month, and trip duration criteria.

claims.claim: Signed-in users have access to the cruise search criteria in the flow.
claims.claim_text: Signed-in users have access to the cruise search criteria in the flow.

claims.claim: Anonymous users have the same cruise search criteria and equivalent search behavior.
claims.claim_text: Anonymous users have the same cruise search criteria and equivalent search behavior.

claims.claim: A policy restriction is communicated when anonymous and signed-in search behavior differs.
claims.claim_text: A policy restriction is communicated when anonymous and signed-in search behavior differs.

requirements.evidence_note: The screenshots show a signed-in context with cruise search controls, but no anonymous comparison state or policy-restriction state is shown.

requirements.text: The system shall provide a dedicated pre-search review step or summary panel that lists all selected cruise criteria together and allows the user to edit any one of them before submitting the search.
requirements.rationale: The dedicated review-panel requirement is contradicted by the visible pre-search flow.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall keep the currently configured search criteria visible together before search execution so the user can review the query state.

claims.claim: A dedicated pre-search review step or summary panel is provided before submitting the search.
claims.claim_text: A dedicated pre-search review step or summary panel is provided before submitting the search.

claims.claim: The dedicated review step or summary panel lists all selected cruise criteria together.
claims.claim_text: The dedicated review step or summary panel lists all selected cruise criteria together.

claims.claim: The dedicated review step or summary panel allows editing of individual selected criteria before submission.
claims.claim_text: The dedicated review step or summary panel allows editing of individual selected criteria before submission.

claims.claim: The selected cruise criteria are available together before submission.
claims.claim_text: The selected cruise criteria are available together before submission.

requirements.evidence_note: The full visible pre-search sequence uses inline search controls. Step 9 shows all criteria together inline, but no separate review step or summary panel appears before the Search Cruises action.

requirements.text: The system shall allow the user to filter cruises by an exact itinerary length in days in addition to broad duration bands.
requirements.rationale: The opened duration selector provides visible counter-evidence against exact-day filtering.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall allow cruise searches to be filtered by duration bands such as 2 to 5 days, 6 to 9 days, and 10 plus days.

claims.claim: The system supports broad duration-band filtering.
claims.claim_text: The system supports broad duration-band filtering.

claims.claim: The system allows filtering by an exact itinerary length in days in addition to broad duration bands.
claims.claim_text: The system allows filtering by an exact itinerary length in days in addition to broad duration bands.

requirements.evidence_note: The visible duration choices are broad bands only: 2-5 Days, 6-9 Days, and 10+ Days. No exact day-length option is shown in the open duration choices.
